description: Layer 2: CRA requirement → framework control references and IAM-oriented guidance (original explanatory text, not standard wording).

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(a)  -  No known exploitable vulnerabilities

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Vulnerability disclosure policy, public contact, timely action on reports so IAM-related flaws are discoverable and remediable before shipping.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Minimum security properties for authenticator implementations; reduces implementation vulnerabilities in credential handling.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Integrity verification of software components; catches compromised or outdated IAM libraries before deployment.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: 8.8: systematic vulnerability scanning and remediation. 8.28: secure coding to prevent common authentication flaws.

CC.how_it_helps: Systematic vulnerability assessment and flaw remediation so known vulnerabilities are found and fixed.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(b)  -  Secure by default configuration

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: No universal defaults; unique pre-installed passwords; crypto for auth; change mechanism; brute-force protection for CRA secure-by-default on IAM.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Credential strength, verifier behaviour, rate limiting; system-generated passwords random and minimum length.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: User identification, authenticator management, password strength per SL, session lock.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Secure baselines, authentication information lifecycle, secure authentication including default credential management.

CC.how_it_helps: Secret quality, protected authentication feedback, manageable security functions for secure changeable defaults.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(c)  -  Security updates including automatic updates

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: IAM patchability; authenticated integrity-checked updates; notification.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Authenticator lifecycle including revocation and renewal; supports patching auth implementations.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Code integrity on updates; component-specific update support.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Patching, controlled installation, change control for IAM patches.

CC.how_it_helps: Flaw remediation process; authentic integrity-verified updates.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(d)  -  Protection from unauthorised access

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Authentication mechanisms; no unauthenticated network access when initialised; minimise exposed surfaces.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: AAL levels, authenticator types, lifecycle, session management for unauthorised access protection.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Full FR1 identification/authentication family plus CR 2.1 authorization enforcement.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Access control policy, identity lifecycle, credentials, privileged access, restriction, secure authentication.

CC.how_it_helps: Identification, authentication, failures, secrets, subject binding, access policy and enforcement.

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Credential storage; no hardcoded secrets; encrypt credentials in transit; crypto for communication.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Password hashing (e.g. memory-hard), authenticator output protection, binding over protected channel.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Confidentiality, cryptography use, PKI and public-key authentication strength.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Cryptographic policy and key management; protection of authentication information.

CC.how_it_helps: Crypto operations and key management; trusted channel for authentication data.

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Software integrity for IAM component; input validation on auth flows.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Verifier impersonation resistance at AAL3; session binding integrity.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Communication integrity, software integrity, audit information protection.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Malware protection, controlled software changes, integrity via MACs/signatures.

CC.how_it_helps: Stored data integrity, inter-TSF integrity transfer, TSF self-test.

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Limit identity data exposure; consent and purpose limitation.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Network segmentation restricting IAM data flows.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Records and PII protection; minimum identity attributes.

CC.how_it_helps: Anonymity, pseudonymity, unlinkability for privacy-preserving auth.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(h)  -  Availability and DoS resilience

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Resilience during cloud IAM outages; local functionality; orderly recovery.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Rate limiting vs brute-force DoS; session timeout and reauthentication.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: DoS protection, resource management, backup and recovery of IAM config/credentials.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Capacity for auth services; ICT continuity for IAM availability.

CC.how_it_helps: Fault tolerance, priority of service, resource allocation for IAM.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(i)  -  Minimise negative impact on other devices

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Unique credentials prevent fleet-wide compromise; reduced attack surface.

CC.how_it_helps: Residual information protection; TSF domain separation.

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Disable unused interfaces; minimise unauthenticated access; hardware exposure.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Mobile code, resources, physical I/O control.

CC.how_it_helps: Fail secure; explicit management functions (no hidden IAM interfaces).

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Rate limiting, impersonation resistance, replay resistance.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Input validation, failed login handling, communication integrity.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Secure coding and application security for IAM.

CC.how_it_helps: Auth failures, trusted recovery, vulnerability analysis.

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(l)  -  Security-related logging and monitoring

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Security telemetry including auth anomalies; user data in logs / opt-out.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Failed auth logging; session activity logging.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Auditable events, storage, failures, timestamps, accessibility, monitoring.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Logging policy, monitoring, clock sync (esp. Architecture B).

CC.how_it_helps: Audit generation, review, storage, selection (supports opt-out).

requirements.title: Annex I, 2(m)  -  Secure data removal and transfer

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Deletion of personal data including from associated cloud IAM services.

CC.how_it_helps: No residual credential data after deletion.

requirements.title: Annex I, Part II  -  Vulnerability handling (incl. SBOM / dependencies)

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: CVD policy, contact, timely action, full update mechanism (TS 103 701). 5.2-1 supports component awareness for disclosure.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Authenticator lifecycle supports remediation in auth mechanism. SBOM/composition not primary focus of 63B.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Defect and security update management (4-1); SM-9/SM-10 third-party component management for IAM dependencies.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Vulnerability management, reporting, contacts; 5.9/5.21 inventory and supply chain for IAM libraries.

CC.how_it_helps: Flaw remediation and vulnerability analysis; ALC_TAT/LCD for dependency and lifecycle tracking.

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Disclosure infrastructure for reports that may trigger Art. 14.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Not directly addressed; reporting is regulatory not authentication technical.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: Issue tracking and closure notification for reporting timelines.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Authority contacts; incident management planning and response.

CC.how_it_helps: Notification procedures for affected users (Art. 14(8) support).

EN_303_645.how_it_helps: Map Annex II obligations to product instructions; EN 303 645 supports baseline consumer IoT documentation expectations where relevant.

NIST_63B.how_it_helps: Use for authenticator and session behaviour described to users where applicable.

IEC_62443_4_2.how_it_helps: SR 1.x and 2.x inform what must be documented for operators.

ISO_27002.how_it_helps: Documentation of access and authentication policies for users.

CC.how_it_helps: Operational and preparative user guidance (CC documentation families).
